title: Very little is needed to make a happy life

lines.text: Most of us just forget to open it.
Man complains of the night, yet the sun still rises for him.
He curses the obstacle, yet the obstacle becomes the way.
The strongest men are not the ones who never fall, but the ones who rise each morning to do the work of a human being.
A man who masters his own mind will find peace anywhere. In a palace. In a war tent. In a storm.
And so, he is far richer than the one who owns the world.
Nothing is easier than to blame the world.
Nothing is more powerful than to change your mind about it.
The line between a good day and a bad one is not drawn by fortune, but by your thoughts.
Your soul takes the color of your thoughts.
So do not wait for a better life.
Very little is needed to make a happy life.
